churn.title: Churn

rows.group: Linear terms present in every seed, same direction

rows.name: Service calls, day usage, evening usage, night usage, international plan, voice mail, state

rows.group: Linear terms present in some seeds only, or with a direction that differs
Non-linear: bends and interactions, most-used first

rows.name: \textbf{Service-call threshold}: churn flat over the first calls, steep from 4 calls
\textbf{Heavy-day hinge}: heavy daytime use: churn climbs steeply above about 300 minutes
\textbf{Day $+$ evening bill}: the combined bill: evening minutes raise churn more for heavy day users
\textbf{Service calls $\times$ light day use}: the service-call rise is strongest for light daytime users
\textbf{Evening bend}: a bend in evening use
\textbf{Heavy day use without voice mail}: heavy daytime use matters mostly without a voice-mail plan
\textbf{Service calls $\times$ voice mail}: service calls read with the voice-mail plan
rows.usual: a single gate that also reads another input

rows.name: \textbf{International-minutes bend}: a bend in international minutes
\textbf{Day $\times$ night usage}: day and night use read together
\textbf{Evening usage $\times$ service calls}: evening use read with service calls

legend: a single gate that also reads another input

heart100.title: Heart-100

rows.group: Linear terms present in every seed, same direction

rows.name: Female (vs male), typical angina, atypical angina, non-anginal pain, cholesterol, sT depression, flat ST slope, vessels coloured, thallium reversible defect

rows.group: Linear terms present in some seeds only, or with a direction that differs
Non-linear units, by family (the inputs that switch the unit on or off)

rows.name: \textbf{Thallium-scan gate}: the thallium scan read through a gate, with ST depression in 9 of 11 units
\textbf{Resting blood pressure}: a threshold, alone (3 of 10 units) or with exercise angina, ST slope, thallium scan or heart rate (others in single units)
\textbf{Exercise angina}: a gate, read with sex in 3 of 4 seeds (on mostly for women in 2)
\textbf{Age brake}: the rise of risk with age slows past an age (5 of 6 units)
\textbf{Maximum-heart-rate bend}: a bend or gate in peak heart rate
\textbf{ST-depression threshold}: counted only past a threshold in 2 of 3 units
\textbf{Flat ST segment step}: a step, read with cholesterol, chest pain, exercise angina or sex
\textbf{Resting-ECG gate}: the resting ECG through a switching unit
\textbf{Thallium scan $\times$ age}: the thallium scan read with age
rows.usual: raises risk for some patients, lowers it for others

rows.name: \textbf{Other (one network each)}: ST slope $\times$ age, chest pain, sex, vessels $\times$ age

legend: raises risk for some patients, lowers it for others
